$comment: Committed defaults. Machine-specific absolute paths go in workspace.local.json (git-ignored). Relative paths resolve against the repo root.

hyperframes.$comment: version: the HyperFrames CLI that rcg runs through npx, for every agent. Keep it in step with the HyperFrames skills installed by `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes` (SETUP.md). usePlugin: true would use an installed Claude Code plugin's launcher and version instead.

voiceStudio.$comment: AditsVoiceStudio, called in place for cloned voices (rcg voice say --clone <slug>): root = the app folder, python = its venv's python (null: bin.meloPython). Machine paths go in workspace.local.json.

cut.$comment: rcg cut (tools/cut/cut.mjs). whisperModel must already be cached (rcg doctor checks); language null = detect. maxPause: pauses over this are tightened to 2/3 of it. pad: kept round each cut. gapQuietDb: a gap between words is trimmed as a pause when it stays this far under speech; ai-video-editor uses 12, which ate a soft 'okay' on a real take (2026-10-12), 15 kept it. keepFillers: never cut um/uh or soft fillers.

keys.$comment: API keys go in workspace.local.json (git-ignored), never here. pixabay: free key from pixabay.com/api/docs/ after login (rcg assets).
